tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures favor a gradient-modulated siphon driving a coupled memory state. The pilot horizons already bracket the target H = 0.46; the unresolved issue is whether the five parameters can be identified. Acquire the targeted trajectory batch to bring the fit to at least eight observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom and may not separate the fast memory time constant from the coupling strength.
Not offered, and the pilot gradient span does not show the narrow-gradient ambiguity this probe targets.
It does not help identify the coupled transient.
